package consumer

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationqueryproduct/authors"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationqueryproduct/blog"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationqueryproduct/project"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/schema/ir"
)

func compileRelationQuerySurface() error {
	relations, err := project.BindRelations()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var name orm.Predicate[blog.Post] = relations.BlogPost.Author.Name.Exact("Ada")
	var identifier orm.Predicate[blog.Post] = relations.BlogPost.Author.ID.Exact(1)
	_ = blog.PostObjects.Using(nil).Filter(name, identifier).OrderBy(blog.PostFields.ID.Asc()).Plan()
	_, err = relations.BlogPost.ParseDynamic(nil, []orm.LookupInput{{Key: "author__name", Value: "Ada"}})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	binding, err := project.Bind()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	post, err := orm.BindModel(binding, ir.ModelIdentity{AppLabel: "blog", ModelName: "post"}, blog.PostDescriptor{})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	author, err := orm.BindModel(binding, ir.ModelIdentity{AppLabel: "authors", ModelName: "author"}, authors.AuthorDescriptor{})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	forward, err := orm.BindForward(post, "author", author)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = forward.String(authors.AuthorFields.Name)
	return err
}
